_comment: MAJ-7 sanctioned adapter compatibility quirks. Files listed here may branch on `model.provider === "<literal>"` or `!== "<literal>"` (either operand order) to tune headers / params / thinking format / capabilities for real gateway compatibility. This is NOT adapter selection — the dispatch key is always model.api (models.ts byApi[model.api] / compat.ts getApiProvider). scripts/check-no-provider-dispatch.mjs asserts that NO provider-literal branch appears in packages/providers/src/api/ outside this whitelist, and that no `switch (provider)` selects an adapter. Keys are paths relative to packages/providers/src. Field-to-field `X.provider === model.provider` comparisons are not quirks and are excluded by the literal-only regex. Do NOT widen this list to fold in coding-agent files — that scope is intentionally excluded (product-side attribution is legal there; A1 handles step-provider).
